profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer with more than 15 years of background in software application development, especially the planning and design of solution architecture. 
Adept at requirement and technical analysis, as well as system upgrades, optimization, coding new features, code review, deploying and maintenance legacy system. 
Expert coordinator, creating high-level architecture design, communicating with offshore teams and diverse professionals, reviewing completed modules, and resolving complex issues using the latest technologies such as .Net, Java, Web Component, ReactJS, Restful API, SQL Server, Redis-Cache, MessageQueue, Jenkins CI/CD, Docker, AWS cloud, Azure cloud...

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Transitioning monolith code to microservices in AWS
- Develop and maintain multiple services and applications
- Support offshore teams to resolve any difficult technical issue.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Build, operate, maintain upgrade a Logistic solution
-Design overview system architect and detail architect from infrastructure to software, from frontend to backend of the system. More than 1000 employees use the system 24/7, The system must be scalability, availability, stability, performance, security
-Actively support the development teams with solution advice, presentations, training.
Implementing DevOps, CD, CI, Scrum 
-Technologies used: .NET Core, Window Form, Restful API, WCF, ReactJS app, React Native, MariaDB, SQL Server, ElasticSearch, Kibana, MongoDB, GitLab, TeamCity, OctopusDeploy, MicroService, Haproxy, Nginx, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, Jira, RabbitMQ, Ant Design, Bootstrap, WebSocket, asp.net SignalR

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Building an E-ticket system for Vietnam Railways Corporation 
-Working as many roles at projects: Solution Architect, Technical leader, DevOps, Developer, PM
-The E-ticket system is designed on the principle of providing multiple channels to sell tickets and making it easy for anyone, anytime, anywhere.
-The hardest problem of the project is how to satisfy complex business and working very high performance special at peak time (TET holiday), the system has to serve 100K concurrent users.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work with  Episerver CMS. My responsibility focuses on:
- Investigating and analyzing requirements with PO/PM
- Planning
- Implementation
- Unit Testing / Self Testing
- Deployment and release
- Maintenance
- Documentation / Training
- Performance tuning

positions.title: EPiServer  - Developer Support Engineer
positions.description:
- Provide development assistance to the EPIServer Developer Community and troubleshoot complex issues.
- Manage resolution of issues, including escalation, system testing, strategy sessions and distribution of knowledge throughout the company
- Write sample code, technical articles, and tutorials, above and beyond documentation, on an as-needed basis.
- Act as the bridge between Support and Engineering/Product Management
- Perform troubleshooting sessions with developers on API integrations.
- Review customer code samples to identify issues and escalate to Engineering.

positions.title: Development Team Lead
positions.description:
I managed a team working for many projects for Japan and Vietnam market.
Project Management and Monitoring.
- Work with program teams and customers (internal and external) to develop plans ensuring a successful online testing experience.
- Assist in the development of project schedules.
- Coordination of discussions between multiple groups and individuals of varying levels within the organization to recognize the successful product and project deliveries.
- Assist in the creation of documentation, potentially customer-facing, as requested by program and project teams.
- Perform and attend cross-training activities within the organization.
- Support program teams on updates to existing platforms as well as programs new to online testing.
- Assist program teams in the development and delivery of training materials to support online testing.
- Prioritize and organize numerous program/project tasks.
Technologies: .Net, Java, JSF, Sql server, Oracle, Php, Mysql, PostgreSQL...

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop many web applications based on asp.net, PHP.
- Develop some window applications based on VB.
- IT administrator.

projects.title: Railway e-ticket system
projects.description:
Build e-Ticket system using many technologies: SPA, angularjs, android app, window form, rest api, nodejs, websocket, redis, sql server, mariadb, elasticsearch, mongodb, git, auto deployment, vmware esxi, haproxy,nginx, citrix, micro services, BI report...
Work as Solution Architect

projects.title: TimeSheet solution
projects.description:
Develop EfficientTime solution, which is a cloud-based Timesheet solution.  It’s based on Microsoft’s Azure cloud platform
Work as Project Manager
- Developing the Project Plan
- Managing the Project Schedule
- Managing Stakeholders
- Facilitating Project Meetings
- Managing Issues & Risks (elevating as necessary)
- Managing Dependencies and Conflicts
- Regular Reporting of Status
